steps.title: One Letter Only
steps.instruction: You must change exactly one letter from the previous word. Try changing I to A: submit LAKE

steps.title: Key Letters Found!
steps.instruction: Great! A and E turned blue - they're Key Letters in the final word.

steps.title: Question Marks
steps.instruction: Notice: ? means those letters haven't been verified yet. Let's test more letters.

steps.title: Testing More Letters
steps.instruction: Try LEAD to see if D is a key letter: (You’re free to rearrange, just change one letter.)

steps.title: Used Keys
steps.instruction: No Keys discovered but if you look at used keys, there are blue dots below it.

steps.title: Proximity Clues
steps.instruction: Blue dots: # of key letters directly next to that letter on the keyboard. There is 1 Key around K.

steps.title: Using the Clues
steps.instruction: K is next to M, J, I, O, and L. But L isn’t a Key Letter, no blue dots.

steps.title: Deduction Time
steps.instruction: So from M, J, I, and O, let's use M. Submit MEAL:

steps.title: Finding the Last Key
steps.instruction: Now we can see there are 2 Keys around D Lets try C. Submit LACE:

steps.title: All Keys Found!
steps.instruction: Excellent! All key letters found: A, C, E, and M. Now make a word using all of them.

steps.title: The Final Word
steps.instruction: Keep in mind, you must change 1 letter at a time. Try MACE:

steps.title: Game Modes
steps.instruction: You're playing Turns Mode (limited moves). There's also Speed Mode (unlimited moves, timed).

steps.title: Settings
steps.instruction: You can switch modes in Settings. Speed Mode is great for competitive players who want to race the clock!

steps.title: Ready to Play!
steps.instruction: You're all set! Try today's daily puzzle or explore past puzzles in Archives.
